name: Robot Components Library
description: Individual component prompts for mix-and-match robot building

rgb_camera.name: RGB Camera Module
rgb_camera.prompt:
Create an RGB camera module:

1. Housing:
   - Cube 35mm x 35mm x 25mm
   - Rounded corners (2mm radius)
   - Matte black plastic

2. Lens assembly:
   - Cylindrical barrel, 12mm diameter
   - Protrudes 5mm from front face
   - Multiple lens elements visible
   - Glass front element (reflective)

3. Details:
   - IR cut filter ring (red tint)
   - Focus ring texture
   - LED indicator (small red dot)
   - Mounting bracket on bottom
   - Ribbon cable connector on back

4. Materials:
   - Housing: mat_plastic_black
   - Lens barrel: mat_aluminum_anodized
   - Glass: mat_lens_glass (slight blue coating)

Name: 'component_camera_rgb'

depth_camera.name: Intel RealSense Style Depth Camera
depth_camera.prompt:
Create a stereo depth camera (RealSense D400 style):

1. Main housing:
   - Elongated rectangle: 90mm x 25mm x 25mm
   - Angular industrial design
   - Silver/gray metallic finish

2. Stereo cameras:
   - Two identical lenses at left/right ends
   - 8mm diameter each
   - Spacing: 50mm baseline
   - Slight recess in housing

3. IR projector:
   - Center of housing
   - Small dome shape
   - Dot pattern projector look

4. RGB camera (optional):
   - Small lens between stereo pair
   - 4mm diameter

5. Details:
   - Intel logo indent
   - USB-C port on side
   - Mounting threads (1/4-20)
   - Status LED strip

6. Materials:
   - Housing: mat_realsense_silver (metallic gray)
   - Lenses: mat_glass_dark
   - IR dome: mat_glass_ir_tint

Name: 'component_camera_depth'

lidar_2d.name: 2D LiDAR Scanner (RPLIDAR Style)
lidar_2d.prompt:
Create a 2D scanning LiDAR:

1. Base housing:
   - Cylinder 70mm diameter, 35mm height
   - Flat top for rotating assembly
   - Matte black finish

2. Rotating head:
   - Slightly smaller cylinder on top
   - 65mm diameter, 15mm height
   - Visible seam line at junction

3. Optical window:
   - Band around rotating head
   - 10mm height
   - Glossy black material
   - Transmits IR laser

4. Base details:
   - Data cable exit (side)
   - Mounting holes (3x, 120° apart)
   - Status LEDs (2x green)
   - Rubber feet

5. Materials:
   - Housing: mat_lidar_black (RGB 0.05, 0.05, 0.08)
   - Window: mat_glass_black (glossy)
   - LEDs: mat_led_green (emissive)

Name: 'component_lidar_2d'

lidar_3d.name: 3D LiDAR (Velodyne/Ouster Style)
lidar_3d.prompt:
Create a multi-beam 3D LiDAR:

1. Main body:
   - Cylinder 100mm diameter
   - Height 120mm
   - Domed top

2. Sensor head:
   - Multi-faceted drum shape
   - 16/32/64 channel appearance
   - Visible optical windows in rows

3. Optical apertures:
   - Array of small windows
   - Stacked vertically
   - 16 rows for 16-channel look
   - Each 5mm x 3mm

4. Base section:
   - Connector panel
   - Power input
   - Ethernet port
   - GPS/PPS connector

5. Cooling:
   - Ventilation slots
   - Heatsink fins (optional)

6. Materials:
   - Body: mat_lidar_black
   - Windows: mat_glass_ir_dark
   - Connectors: various metals

Name: 'component_lidar_3d'

ultrasonic.name: Ultrasonic Distance Sensor (HC-SR04)
ultrasonic.prompt:
Create an HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor:

1. PCB base:
   - Rectangle 45mm x 20mm x 2mm
   - Green solder mask color
   - Visible copper traces

2. Transducers (2x):
   - Cylindrical cans: 16mm diameter, 12mm height
   - Silver aluminum body
   - Mesh front face
   - Spacing: 25mm center-to-center

3. PCB components:
   - Crystal oscillator (small silver can)
   - IC chip (black rectangle)
   - Resistors/capacitors (small SMD)
   - 'HC-SR04' silkscreen text

4. Connections:
   - 4-pin header (VCC, Trig, Echo, GND)
   - Mounting holes at corners

5. Materials:
   - PCB: mat_pcb_green
   - Transducers: mat_aluminum_mesh
   - Components: various

Name: 'component_ultrasonic'

imu.name: 9-DOF IMU Module
imu.prompt:
Create a 9-axis IMU breakout board:

1. PCB:
   - Square 25mm x 25mm x 1.5mm
   - Blue solder mask (or purple)
   - Gold-plated pads

2. Main IC:
   - QFN package center
   - 4mm x 4mm black chip
   - Tiny pin markings

3. Support components:
   - Decoupling capacitors (4x tiny)
   - Pull-up resistors
   - Voltage regulator (small)

4. Markings:
   - Axis arrows (X, Y, Z)
   - Pin labels
   - Board name
   - Adafruit/SparkFun style

5. Connections:
   - Header pin holes along edge
   - I2C/SPI interface
   - Interrupt pins

6. Materials:
   - PCB: mat_pcb_blue
   - Pads: mat_gold
   - Chips: mat_ic_black

Name: 'component_imu'

wheel_standard.name: Standard Drive Wheel
wheel_standard.prompt:
Create a standard robot wheel:

1. Tire:
   - Torus/cylinder: 80mm diameter, 25mm width
   - Rounded profile
   - Rubber material with tread pattern

2. Tread pattern:
   - Circumferential grooves (3-4)
   - Or block tread pattern
   - 3mm depth

3. Hub:
   - Center disc: 30mm diameter
   - 5 curved spokes
   - Central bore for shaft (6mm)
   - Set screw detail

4. Hub cap (optional):
   - Covers center
   - Logo placement area

5. Materials:
   - Tire: mat_rubber_black (roughness 0.8)
   - Hub: mat_aluminum_brushed
   - Spokes: mat_aluminum_anodized

Name: 'component_wheel_standard'

wheel_mecanum.name: Mecanum Wheel
wheel_mecanum.prompt:
Create a mecanum omnidirectional wheel:

1. Hub structure:
   - Two parallel discs: 60mm diameter
   - Connected by central shaft
   - Mounting plate on inner side

2. Roller array:
   - 9-12 barrel-shaped rollers
   - Each roller: 25mm long, 15mm diameter
   - Angled 45° to wheel axis
   - Free-spinning on pins

3. Roller pins:
   - Steel axles through rollers
   - Mounted between hub discs
   - Equally spaced around circumference

4. Roller detail:
   - Slight barrel curve (convex)
   - Rubber outer surface
   - Bearing ends visible

5. Hub details:
   - Motor mounting pattern
   - Keyway or set screw

6. Materials:
   - Hub: mat_aluminum_anodized_black
   - Rollers: mat_rubber_gray
   - Pins: mat_steel

Note: Wheel orientation matters!
- Left wheels: rollers angle one way
- Right wheels: rollers angle opposite

Name: 'component_wheel_mecanum'

servo_standard.name: Standard Hobby Servo
servo_standard.prompt:
Create a standard hobby servo:

1. Body:
   - Rectangular: 40mm x 20mm x 38mm
   - Mounting ears on sides
   - 4 mounting holes (M3)

2. Output shaft:
   - Top center
   - Splined shaft: 5mm diameter
   - Brass insert visible

3. Wire:
   - 3-wire cable exiting body
   - Orange/red/brown colors
   - JR/Futaba connector

4. Details:
   - Screw heads on case
   - Label area with specs
   - Gear train visible through case (hint)

5. Horn (optional):
   - Cross or disc horn
   - Attaches to output
   - Mounting screw hole

6. Materials:
   - Body: mat_plastic_black or mat_plastic_blue
   - Output: mat_brass
   - Wire: colored plastics

Name: 'component_servo_standard'

servo_dynamixel.name: Smart Servo (Dynamixel Style)
servo_dynamixel.prompt:
Create a Dynamixel-style smart servo:

1. Body:
   - Compact rectangle: 40mm x 36mm x 50mm
   - Mounting frames on both ends
   - Multiple mounting hole patterns

2. Output:
   - Centered on one face
   - Splined output hub
   - Position sensor built-in

3. Connectors:
   - 2x TTL/RS485 ports (daisy chain)
   - Molex-style connectors
   - On back face

4. Features:
   - Metal gear train (implied)
   - Aluminum heat sink integrated
   - ID display area
   - LED indicator window

5. Frame details:
   - Idler bearing on opposite end
   - Quick-connect frame system

6. Materials:
   - Body: mat_dynamixel_black
   - Frame: mat_aluminum_black
   - Output: mat_steel

Name: 'component_servo_dynamixel'

motor_brushless.name: Brushless DC Motor
motor_brushless.prompt:
Create a brushless DC motor:

1. Motor body:
   - Cylinder: 40mm diameter, 50mm length
   - Mounting face with bolt pattern
   - Cooling fins around body (optional)

2. Output shaft:
   - Steel shaft: 5mm diameter
   - Extends 15mm from front
   - Flat for set screw

3. Encoder:
   - Rear housing extension
   - Glass disc encoder (implied)
   - Connector on back

4. Wiring:
   - 3-phase wires (A, B, C)
   - Color coded: black, red, blue
   - Exiting from side or rear

5. Details:
   - Manufacturer label
   - Specs printed (KV rating)
   - Front bearing visible

6. Materials:
   - Body: mat_motor_aluminum
   - End caps: mat_aluminum_black
   - Shaft: mat_steel

Name: 'component_motor_bldc'

gripper_parallel.name: Parallel Jaw Gripper
gripper_parallel.prompt:
Create a parallel jaw gripper:

1. Body/housing:
   - Main block: 80mm x 40mm x 40mm
   - Contains linear actuator
   - Mounting flange on top

2. Guide rails:
   - Two parallel rails
   - Fingers slide along these
   - Visible ball bearings/slides

3. Fingers (2x):
   - L-shaped profile
   - Base: 25mm x 30mm x 10mm
   - Tip extending down: 40mm
   - Move symmetrically

4. Finger tips:
   - Interchangeable pads
   - Rubber gripping surface
   - Serrated or textured

5. Sensors:
   - Force sensor in each finger
   - Position encoder
   - Object detection (optional)

6. Connections:
   - Air line (pneumatic) or
   - Electrical connector
   - Signal/sensor cable

7. Materials:
   - Body: mat_aluminum_anodized_gray
   - Fingers: mat_aluminum_machined
   - Pads: mat_rubber_grip

Name: 'component_gripper_parallel'

jetson_orin_nano.name: NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano Developer Kit
jetson_orin_nano.prompt:
Create NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano:

1. Carrier board:
   - PCB: 100mm x 80mm x 2mm
   - Green solder mask
   - Dense component placement

2. Jetson module:
   - Black rectangle on PCB
   - 70mm x 45mm x 8mm
   - 260-pin connector underneath

3. Heatsink:
   - Aluminum finned heatsink
   - 65mm x 40mm x 15mm
   - NVIDIA logo embossed
   - Optional fan mount

4. Ports (along edges):
   - USB: 4x Type-A (2 stacks of 2)
   - Ethernet: 1x RJ45
   - Display: HDMI + DisplayPort
   - Power: Barrel jack DC
   - GPIO: 40-pin header
   - Camera: 2x CSI connectors

5. Other connectors:
   - M.2 slot (with SSD option)
   - MicroSD slot
   - Debug UART header

6. Materials:
   - PCB: mat_pcb_green_nvidia
   - Module: mat_plastic_black
   - Heatsink: mat_aluminum_silver
   - Ports: standard colors

Name: 'component_jetson_orin'

raspberry_pi.name: Raspberry Pi 5
raspberry_pi.prompt:
Create Raspberry Pi 5:

1. Main PCB:
   - Size: 85mm x 56mm (credit card)
   - Green PCB (classic Pi color)
   - Dense double-sided components

2. Main SoC:
   - BCM2712 chip center
   - Small heatsink on top
   - Silver thermal pad visible

3. Ports (organized by edge):
   USB side:
   - 2x USB 3.0 (blue)
   - 2x USB 2.0 (black)
   - Gigabit Ethernet (with LEDs)

   Video side:
   - 2x micro HDMI

   Power side:
   - USB-C power input
   - Power button (new in Pi 5)

   Other side:
   - 3.5mm audio jack
   - MIPI CSI camera connector
   - MIPI DSI display connector

4. GPIO:
   - 40-pin header
   - Gold pins, black housing
   - Standard Pi pinout

5. Other:
   - MicroSD slot on bottom
   - PCIe connector (new)
   - PoE header
   - Raspberry Pi logo

6. Materials:
   - PCB: mat_pcb_raspberry_green
   - Chips: mat_ic_packages
   - Ports: standard colors

Name: 'component_raspberry_pi_5'

battery_lipo.name: LiPo Battery Pack
battery_lipo.prompt:
Create a LiPo battery pack:

1. Main body:
   - Soft rectangle: 150mm x 50mm x 30mm
   - Rounded edges (safety)
   - Shrink wrap texture

2. Main connector:
   - XT60 style (yellow)
   - Or EC3/Deans
   - Positive/negative markings

3. Balance connector:
   - JST-XH multi-pin
   - White housing
   - Wire leads

4. Label:
   - Specifications printed:
     - Voltage: 22.2V (6S)
     - Capacity: 5000mAh
     - Discharge: 50C
   - Warning symbols
   - Manufacturer branding

5. Charge indicator (optional):
   - 4-LED strip on side
   - Check button

6. Materials:
   - Body: mat_battery_wrap (black matte)
   - XT60: mat_plastic_yellow
   - Balance: mat_plastic_white

Name: 'component_battery_lipo'

led_ring.name: RGB LED Status Ring
led_ring.prompt:
Create an addressable LED ring:

1. PCB ring:
   - Torus shape: 60mm outer, 40mm inner
   - 3mm thick
   - Black PCB (for contrast)

2. LED chips:
   - 12x WS2812B (or 16, 24)
   - Evenly spaced around ring
   - 5mm x 5mm each
   - White/clear lens on each

3. Connections:
   - 3-pin input (5V, GND, Data)
   - Optional output for chaining
   - Solder pads or JST

4. Diffuser (optional):
   - Frosted cover over LEDs
   - Softens light output
   - Translucent white material

5. Mounting:
   - Screw holes (3x)
   - Or adhesive backing

6. Materials:
   - PCB: mat_pcb_black
   - LED lens: mat_plastic_clear
   - Emission: mat_led_rgb (adjustable)

7. Default emission:
   - Cyan color: RGB(0, 0.8, 1.0)
   - Strength: 5.0

Name: 'component_led_ring'

antenna_wifi.name: WiFi/BT Antenna
antenna_wifi.prompt:
Create a WiFi/Bluetooth antenna:

1. Antenna body:
   - Flat paddle shape
   - 15mm x 80mm x 8mm
   - Rounded top
   - Rubber/plastic coating

2. Hinge/swivel:
   - Articulating base
   - Allows angle adjustment
   - Knurled grip ring

3. Connector:
   - SMA or RP-SMA
   - Gold-plated threads
   - Center pin visible

4. Internal element (hint):
   - Wire pattern visible through housing
   - PCB antenna inside

5. Markings:
   - WiFi symbol
   - Frequency bands (2.4/5GHz)
   - Gain rating (optional)

6. Materials:
   - Body: mat_rubber_black
   - Connector: mat_gold_plated
   - Base: mat_plastic_black

Name: 'component_antenna_wifi'
